title: [main] bug 640925 - Add report extension for Standard Sales Pro Forma and Draft Invoice
summary: Czech report extensions add missing fields to draft and pro forma invoices for approval workflows, matching the layout of posted Czech invoices with registration numbers, VAT dates, bank details, and payment information.
key_points: Two new report extensions (11707, 11708) extend reports 1303 and 1302 with Czech RDLC layouts
Added header fields include registration numbers, VAT date, bank account details, payment symbols, payment terms and method, salesperson and employee info, and exchange rate
Pro forma extension adds a VAT Amount Line dataitem for VAT recapitulation, reading sales lines directly
No QR code is included because the documents are not posted
Layouts are clearly marked as draft or pro forma to distinguish them from final tax documents
